run_estimate_moge: run estimate_moge.py to estimate 3D point clouds from images using the MoGe model
create_ImageFolderDataset: create an ImageFolderDataset to load images from folders with scannet-like or sam-like directory structures
split_dataset: split a combined dataset into n equal subsets and return the m-th subset for distributed processing
save_points_masks: save estimated 3D points and invalid masks as numpy files to designated output folders
test_estimate_moge: test estimate_moge.py with sample image folders and visualize results using wandb
